summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError(Exception), following the seven workflow steps. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture, parametrized valid and invalid path tests, None/string input tests, and a graph-unchanged check. Ran pytest on the new tests plus test/test_path.py with the shared venv: 42 passed. Not verified: mypy (warn_unused_ignores) and black, since neither is installed in the shared venv and I did not install them. Nothing was committed, and no existing modules were changed.
